mapper.select: select s.seal_id, s.user_id, s.seal_name, s.seal_image_url, s.material_urls, s.review_status, s.seal_status, s.reject_reason, s.reviewer_id, s.review_time, s.create_time, u.nick_name, u.user_name from sys_copyright_seal s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id where s.seal_id = #{sealId} and s.is_deleted = 0

select log_id, seal_id, operation_type, from_status, to_status, reason, operator_id, operator_name, create_time from sys_copyright_seal_log where seal_id = #{sealId} order by create_time desc, log_id desc
mapper.update: update sys_copyright_seal set review_status = #{reviewStatus}, reject_reason = #{reason}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where seal_id = #{sealId} and is_deleted = 0 and review_status = 'pending'

update sys_copyright_seal set seal_status = #{sealStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where seal_id = #{sealId} and is_deleted = 0 and review_status = 'approved' and seal_status = #{expectedStatus}

update sys_copyright_seal set seal_status = 'disabled', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where seal_id = #{sealId} and is_deleted = 0 and review_status = 'approved' and seal_status = 'abnormal'
mapper.insert: insert into sys_copyright_seal_log (seal_id, operation_type, from_status, to_status, reason, operator_id, operator_name, create_time) values (#{sealId}, #{operationType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{createTime})
